name: Freeform Surfaces via Quadric Perturbation
aliases: Functionally Defined Objects (Freeform Surfaces via Quadric Perturbation)
definition: A method to represent complex 3D geometry using a continuous real-valued describing function F(X) >= 0, where X=(x1,x2,x3). The object is the closed subset of Euclidean space where the function is non-negative. It allows visualization of both the surface and internal structure.
